The first time I smoked weed was when I was 16. I had smoked previously, but definetly not enough to get truely stoned. A friend from school said he had some 'good weed' and that he would give me a joint if I wanted it, of course, I said yes.
Later that day, at around 3pm, I took my parents car to a friends house. She doesent smoke, but her sister is quite experienced. My friend who doesent smoke and I decided to go to a place by the river that people usually use to smoke pot. After hearing that I had weed, my friends sister asked if I would smoke it with her. I had to think about it for a bit because I promised I would smoke it with another friend later that night, but I ended up saying yes.
Instead of going to the place by the river, she said we could just smoke it on the deck at her house (her parents are totally cool with it, her dad is a HUGE stoner so its awesome). Anyway, we stood outside while I lit it up. After about 2 or 3 hits from it, I began to get really paranoid that someone I knew would drive by and see me and tell my parents. After she had a couple more hits, she told me I could finish it. After I was done, I didnt really feel high, just slightly buzzed. I remembered that I had to pick my sister up so my non-smoker friend and I got into the car and started to drive away (Yes, I know.. driving while intoxicated is very stupid, but I didnt know what to expect). So we pulled out of her driveway, and as we started driving I began to get this tingly sensation in my back and this goofy looking smile on my face. I picked up my sister and she knew what was up, she was cool with it though and just laughed.
The 3 of us began driving again to get some ice cream. During the drive, my friend began playing techno music. As most of you know, listening to music can be one of the funnest things to do while stoned, but this time it wasnt so fun. The beats in the music sounded like they were in my head, like I was the only one who could hear it. My heart began beating really fast so I shut it off.
When we got to the ice cream place I tried to order my ice cream but just couldnt get the words out, so my sister ordered it for me. We sat at a picnic table close by to enjoy our ice cream. At this point, everything seemed funny to me. I remember that my friend had a bracelet on and I looked at it and began to laugh. My friend asked me what I was laughing about and I relpied with 'You have ice cream on your wrist', she looked at me like I was crazy, 'Ahh, no' she said, 'thats my bracelet'. I swear, I laughed for 15 minutes straight.
We decided to leave and go for a drive. The drive seemed like it took hours, when it was actually only about 5 minutes. I knew I had to pick my dad up from work later so I stopped into a store to get some gas. As I was getting money out of my wallet, my friend tried to tell me how much to get, but I wasnt comprehending her words, it just seemed like she was talking to me, but I couldnt hear her. When I finally got the right money, I began pumping gas. I was amazed at the techniques I used and thought I was some how a genius for the way I pumped gas. I went in, paid for the gas and got out of there before anyone realized the redness of my eyes.
We went for a drive through a part of my community where people associate with weed (there are about 6 sellers and a hell of alot of smokers). It seemed like the most beautiful place in the world. I thought, wow... people that come through here do not realize how pretty this place is. My mind continued to wander through the rest of the drive. I was amazed at how good of a driver I was. I stayed the speed limit and was very cautious (I think it was because I was so paranoid of getting pulled over by the cops).
After leaving there, I began to freak out becuase it had felt like we were driving for hours. I thought that I had forgot to pick my dad up from work. I started yelling 'Oh My God'. My sister and friend asked me what was wrong, and assured me that I still had 25 minutes left to pick him up. I felt so relieved, seriously, it was one of the most relaxing things, knowing that I hadnt forgot and that there was still quite a bit of time. After about 15 more minutes of driving, I decided to go pick him up.
I pulled over on the side of the road to examine my eyes, which were completely red. I grabbed a pair of sunglasses and prayed that my dad wouldnt know something was up.
After arriving at my dads workplace, I got paranoid again, but was later calmed down when my friend turned on the radio. The voice of the guy on the radio some how calmed me down. Once we saw my dad coming out, my friend jumped in the back and my dad got it. It was only a short drive home, but again, it seemed like it took forever. I was acting completely normal, except for the occasional slurred word. After dropping him off at home, I told him that I was going to a softball game at my high school and that I wouldnt be long.
It was starting to wear off once we got to the game. I was upset about this but happy at the same time. I got to the game and the friend that I was supposed to share the joint with came running up to me. After talking for a few minutes, she asked where it was. I had to tell her that I had already smoked it, she was mad but got over it. I stood with a big group of friends and just talked. One of my guy friends asked me to go for a walk with him, so I did. He said that he knew I was smoking weed and told me that he wished I wouldnt do it again. I told him that I couldnt promise anything, he just laughed and said he loved me. Not being high, but not being completely sober, this felt like the best thing in the world. I figured out that I did have friends who truely cared about me, this made me feel really good.
I smoke up now about 3 times a week. Its great. My non smoker friend is awesome to be stoned around, we sit and laugh and talk about serious things, which is what I realy like to do while intoxicated, have deep discussions. Weed has made me realize that there is a whole other world out there. There are so many things people are missing.
